title: Enforce admin and member roles
acceptance:
Story: roles keep administration and everyday work apart.
Expected: admin-only routes refuse members, and admin routes never read member files; every role failure uses the uniform error shape with 403.
Not expected: further roles such as guest or moderator; those arrive with sharing in 0.9.
Depends on: WI-13 sessions and WI-14 accounts.
Verify: acceptance drives a member against an admin route and the admin against a member file, and expects refusals.
evidence: Member requests to /invitations and /accounts answer 403 with the uniform error shape, and the admin listing carries no key or digest (node test). PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
